name: KUB-StoneX (Daffodil International University HIRL)
what: 2,570 AP kidney-ureter-bladder radiographs of 1,703 patients from two Bangladeshi hospitals, with pixel-level stone masks and radiomic features; a KUB film is a frontal lumbar spine and pelvis radiograph at abdominal exposure, with the iliac crests and the sacrum in field
level_truth: none; frontal lumbar spine and pelvis
status: found by the sweep of 2026-10-21; not fetched; an open figshare download (32049369, one zip of 20,765,554,562 bytes), entered in grid/fetch-xray.json as kub_stonex on 2026-10-21 (issue #40); the frontal counterpart of what the registry lacks in volume
licence: CC BY 4.0 (the figshare record's licence field, read from the API on 2026-10-21)
how_to_get: The set is figshare article 32049369 (doi 10.6084/m9.figshare.32049369), one file KUB-StoneX.zip with its md5 in the record, 20.8 GB; the record's ethics statement names IRB REC-FSIT-2025/No: 12732 and states every image is de-identified.

Fetch it as a Slurm job on the owner's word, never on the login node, after df shows the room: bash grid/run-xray-chain.sh --only kub_stonex, whose stage 1 reads the API, runs http-get with the md5 and unpacks the zip (grid/README.md).
The person rule of grid/banks/kub_stonex.json is written from the unpacked folder's file naming or its <class>_patient/ folders before the bank stage runs, since 1,703 patients hold 2,570 films.
